commit 5079c80c03efb233788d575af5bcbf5546f5c593
Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Feb 20 14:24:33 2025 +0100
Commit:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Feb 20 14:24:33 2025 +0100

    Bug 1947134 - Make sure the "tree-view" custom element is available before initializing the mail3pane. r=tobyp
    
    The intermittent fail happens when `folderPane.selection` is
    `undefined`.  However, `selection` is a getter for an internal Map,
    which should be available as soon as a new instance of the module is
    created.
    
    I cannot find a scenario where this could happen, except when the
    custom element is not yet defined. We do wait for many other custom
    elements, but not for `tree-view`.
    
    This patch therefore makes sure that the `tree-view` custom element is
    defined, before executing the init code.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D238945

diff --git a/mail/base/content/about3Pane.js b/mail/base/content/about3Pane.js
index 1ceef25d6d1..7282e4fc248 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/about3Pane.js
+++ b/mail/base/content/about3Pane.js
@@ -147,6 +147,7 @@ window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async event => {
   await customElements.whenDefined("folder-tree-row");
   await customElements.whenDefined("thread-row");
   await customElements.whenDefined("thread-card");
+  await customElements.whenDefined("tree-view");
 
   UIDensity.registerWindow(window);
   UIFontSize.registerWindow(window);
